dn9:50.3: yo te bhavissati anāgato attapaṭilābho soyeva te attapaṭilābho sacco mogho atīto mogho paccuppanno
dn9:50.4: yo te etarahi paccuppanno attapaṭilābho soyeva te attapaṭilābho sacco mogho atīto mogho anāgatoti
dn9:50.5: evaṃ puṭṭho tvaṃ citta kinti byākareyyāsīti.
dn9:50.6: sace pana maṃ bhante evaṃ puccheyyuṃ
dn9:50.7: yo te ahosi atīto attapaṭilābho soyeva te attapaṭilābho sacco mogho anāgato mogho paccuppanno
dn9:50.8: yo te bhavissati anāgato attapaṭilābho soyeva te attapaṭilābho sacco mogho atīto mogho paccuppanno
dn9:50.9: yo te etarahi paccuppanno attapaṭilābho soyeva te attapaṭilābho sacco mogho atīto mogho anāgatoti
dn9:50.10: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyaṃ
dn9:50.11: yo ca me ahosi atīto attapaṭilābho soyeva me attapaṭilābho tasmiṃ samaye sacco ahosi mogho anāgato mogho paccuppanno
dn9:50.12: yo ca me bhavissati anāgato attapaṭilābho soyeva me attapaṭilābho tasmiṃ samaye sacco bhavissati mogho atīto mogho paccuppanno
dn9:50.13: yo ca me etarahi paccuppanno attapaṭilābho soyeva me attapaṭilābho sacco mogho atīto mogho anāgatoti
dn9:50.14: evaṃ puṭṭho ahaṃ bhante evaṃ byākareyyanti.
dn9:51.1: evameva kho citta yasmiṃ samaye oḷāriko attapaṭilābho hoti neva tasmiṃ samaye manomayo attapaṭilābhoti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati na arūpo attapaṭilābhoti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati
dn9:51.2: oḷāriko attapaṭilābhotveva tasmiṃ samaye saṅkhyaṃ gacchati
dn9:51.3: yasmiṃ citta samaye manomayo attapaṭilābho hoti …pe…
dn9:51.4: yasmiṃ citta samaye arūpo attapaṭilābho hoti neva tasmiṃ samaye oḷāriko attapaṭilābhoti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati na manomayo attapaṭilābhoti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati
dn9:51.5: arūpo attapaṭilābhotveva tasmiṃ samaye saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
dn9:52.1: seyyathāpi citta gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi dadhimhā navanītaṃ navanītamhā sappi sappimhā sappimaṇḍo
dn9:52.2: yasmiṃ samaye khīraṃ hoti neva tasmiṃ samaye dadhīti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati na ca navanītanti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati na ca sappīti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati na ca sappimaṇḍoti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati
dn9:52.7: sappimaṇḍo hoti neva tasmiṃ samaye khīranti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati na dadhīti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati na navanītanti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati na sappīti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati
dn9:53.1: evameva kho citta yasmiṃ samaye oḷāriko attapaṭilābho hoti neva
dn9:53.2: tasmiṃ samaye manomayo attapaṭilābhoti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati na arūpo attapaṭilābhoti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati oḷāriko attapaṭilābhotveva tasmiṃ samaye saṅkhyaṃ gacchati yasmiṃ samaye citta manomayo attapaṭilābho hoti …pe…
dn9:53.3: arūpo attapaṭilābho hoti neva tasmiṃ samaye oḷāriko attapaṭilābhoti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati na ca manomayo attapaṭilābhoti saṅkhyaṃ gacchati
dn9:53.4: arūpo attapaṭilābhotveva tasmiṃ samaye saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
dn9:53.5: imā kho citta lokasamaññā lokaniruttiyo lokavohārā lokapaññattiyo yāhi tathāgato voharati aparāmasantoti.
dn9:54.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
dn9:55.3: seyyathāpi bhante paṭicchannaṃ …pe… cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
dn9:55.4: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
dn9:55.5: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
dn9:56.1: alattha kho citto hatthisāriputto bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
dn9:56.2: acirūpasampanno kho āyasmā hatthisāriputto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
dn9:56.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
dn9:56.4: aññataro kho āyasmā hatthisāriputto arahataṃ ahosīti.
